name: wataame
source:
A mysterious creature encountered in the open-air baths of "Masaki" Inn. 
The protagonist mistakes it for a sponge and attempts to use it while bathing.
It is actually Meguru's pet lamb.
(Spoilers below)
[spoiler]Found by Meguru and Mihiro after the death of the Ichijou family's pet dog, Shushu.[/spoiler]
